request.summary: Fix Doom of Mokhaiotl (and other chest/reward-interface content) not triggering loot alerts, by consolidating LootAlertListener and AccomplishmentLootListener into one listener that subscribes to all three loot event sources (NpcLootReceived, PlayerLootReceived, and RuneLite's LootReceived filtered to EVENT/PICKPOCKET), independently checking each item against both the value-threshold rule and the mega-rare allowlist (now including the 3 new Mokhaiotl uniques), firing to one or both Discord channels as applicable. Also fixes a chat-message-spoofing bug in PetDropListener and OneTimeRewardListener: neither filters by ChatMessageType, so a clan member typing matching text in public/clan chat can trigger a fake pet/achievement alert (confirmed via a real Discord incident) - both gain a ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE filter, verified against a real reference plugin (discord-notifications) that does the same.
request.raw_requirements:
Bug: item drops from the boss "Doom of Mokhaiotl" are not being caught by LootAlertListener (the big-loot-drop Discord alert). Root cause confirmed: this boss delivers loot through a reward interface/chest (per the OSRS Wiki: "Upon interacting with the burrow hole the Doom leaves behind, players are shown a list of rewards and given the option to claim them and leave, or to risk them by continuing the pursuit"), not a normal NPC-kill drop. LootAlertListener and AccomplishmentLootListener both only subscribe to NpcLootReceived/PlayerLootReceived, which are only fired for direct NPC-kill loot - they never fire for chest/reward-interface-delivered items, regardless of value or item ID.

Investigated the real published "Discord Loot Logger" plugin (info.sigterm.plugins.discordlootlogger, source at github.com/Adam-/runelite-plugins, found via its Plugin Hub manifest) which works correctly for this boss. It subscribes to a THIRD event source in addition to the two we already use: net.runelite.client.plugins.loottracker.LootReceived (published by RuneLite's own bundled Loot Tracker core plugin, not the raw client engine hooks), filtered to LootRecordType.EVENT or LootRecordType.PICKPOCKET (NPC/PLAYER types are skipped since those would duplicate NpcLootReceived/PlayerLootReceived). This EVENT type is RuneLite's own actively-maintained normalized bucket for chest/reward-interface/minigame-style loot that doesn't fire a normal kill event - confirmed via javap against the actual cached client-1.12.39.jar (LootReceived has getName()/getType()/getItems(), LootRecordType enum has NPC/PLAYER/EVENT/PICKPOCKET/UNKNOWN).

Also confirmed via the cached runelite-api jar (gameval ItemID class) that Doom of Mokhaiotl's three unique drops already have real item IDs even though the boss NPC itself doesn't: MOKHAIOTL_CLOTH, EYE_OF_AYAK (there's also an EYE_OF_AYAK_UNCHARGED - need to determine which one actually drops, or track both), AVERNIC_TREADS (note: several other AVERNIC_TREADS_* variants exist for combined-upgrade forms - only the base AVERNIC_TREADS should be tracked, the combined forms are player-crafted, not the drop itself).

Requested fix (decided with the developer after discussing the design): rather than just adding the LootReceived subscription separately to both LootAlertListener and AccomplishmentLootListener (which would duplicate the same three-event-source subscription/dedup logic in two places), consolidate: merge AccomplishmentLootListener's responsibility (the fixed mega-rare item-ID allowlist check, gated on accomplishmentSharingEnabled, posting AlertKind.ACCOMPLISHMENT with a screenshot) into LootAlertListener. LootAlertListener becomes the single subscriber to all three loot event sources (NpcLootReceived, PlayerLootReceived, LootReceived filtered to EVENT/PICKPOCKET); for each item it receives, it independently checks (a) the existing value-threshold rule (non-stackable + >=1.5m gp, gated on lootSharingEnabled, posts AlertKind.LOOT) and (b) the mega-rare allowlist rule (item ID in a fixed set - the existing Twisted bow/Scythe of vitur/Tumeken's shadow/Ancient blood ornament kit plus the 3 new Mokhaiotl items, gated on accomplishmentSharingEnabled, posts AlertKind.ACCOMPLISHMENT). An item matching both rules fires both alerts, to both channels - each gate stays independently toggleable, per the existing architecture decision (architecture.json, 2026-09-16) that these are deliberately separate features/channels/toggles, not merged into one.

AccomplishmentLootListener.java is deleted as a standalone file; its TRACKED_ITEM_IDS set and allowlist-check logic move into LootAlertListener. CatastrophicEventsPlugin.java drops its separate accomplishmentLootListener field/injection/registration (one fewer EventBus listener to wire in startUp()/shutDown()).

Scope note: SkillMilestoneListener and QuestMilestoneListener are NOT part of this task - unrelated event sources (StatChanged, polling).

SECOND BUG folded into this same task (developer decision - keep as one task rather than splitting): PetDropListener and OneTimeRewardListener both react to ChatMessage with no ChatMessageType filter at all, matching purely on message text. This means any player typing matching text in public/clan/private chat as a joke triggers a false alert - confirmed for real via a screenshot of an actual Discord incident (a clan member's chat message containing the exact pet-drop phrase triggered a fake pet alert). Verified the fix by cloning a real, previously-used-and-trusted reference plugin (ThatOhio/RuneLite-Discord-Notifications, the "Discord Notifications" Hub plugin, at its pinned Hub commit 6e9161115d2fbba899a90ee6ac35432cb925604b): its onChatMessage handler filters `if (event.getType() != ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE) return;` before matching pet text, confirming GAMEMESSAGE is the correct type. That same reference plugin's PET_MESSAGES list also revealed a third pet-drop message variant we didn't have: "You have a funny feeling like you would have been followed" (likely the duplicate-pet-roll wording), which should be added to PetDropListener's pattern alongside the existing two. OneTimeRewardListener has the identical missing-filter vulnerability (no reference-plugin evidence for its exact fire cape/infernal cape/Dizana's quiver wording, but the same GAMEMESSAGE filter fix applies by the same principle) - not yet reported as exploited, but logically identical risk, fixed proactively while addressing WRN-006 (the concerns.json entry covering both listeners' unverified-wording risk).

plan.approach: Merge AccomplishmentLootListener's allowlist logic into LootAlertListener, which becomes the single subscriber for all three loot sources (NpcLootReceived, PlayerLootReceived, and LootReceived filtered to EVENT/PICKPOCKET), independently checking each item against the value-threshold rule and the (now 7-item) mega-rare allowlist. Also close a chat-message-spoofing gap in PetDropListener and OneTimeRewardListener by adding a ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE filter to both, verified against a real reference plugin (discord-notifications) that does the same, plus a third confirmed pet-message variant from that same plugin.
steps: Step 1 - LootAlertListener.java: add @Subscribe onLootReceived(LootReceived event), filtered to event.getType() == LootRecordType.EVENT || event.getType() == LootRecordType.PICKPOCKET, calling the existing handleLoot(event.getItems(), event.getName()). Imports: net.runelite.client.plugins.loottracker.LootReceived, net.runelite.http.api.loottracker.LootRecordType.

Step 2 - LootAlertListener.java: add a TRACKED_ACCOMPLISHMENT_ITEM_IDS Set<Integer> (ItemID.TWISTED_BOW, SCYTHE_OF_VITUR, TUMEKENS_SHADOW, ANCIENT_BLOOD_ORNAMENT_KIT, MOKHAIOTL_CLOTH, EYE_OF_AYAK_UNCHARGED, AVERNIC_TREADS). Within handleLoot, add an independent check: if item.getId() is in that set, fire an AlertKind.ACCOMPLISHMENT alert (screenshot + title=composition.getName() + summary="received {name} from {source}") gated on config.accomplishmentSharingEnabled(), alongside (not replacing) the existing value-threshold AlertKind.LOOT check. Mirror AccomplishmentLootListener's exact sendAlert(...) call shape (the title-carrying overload).
Step 4 - CatastrophicEventsPlugin.java: remove the accomplishmentLootListener field/@Inject, and its eventBus.register(...)/unregister(...) calls in startUp()/shutDown().

Step 5 - Manual QA: ./gradlew compileJava to confirm it compiles clean, including that LootReceived/LootRecordType resolve without a new build.gradle dependency (already transitively available via net.runelite:client).

Step 6 - PetDropListener.java: add `if (event.getType() != ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE) { return; }` at the top of onChatMessage, before the text match (import net.runelite.api.ChatMessageType). Add the third pattern alternative "funny feeling like you would have been followed" to the PET_OBTAINED Pattern.
Step 7 - OneTimeRewardListener.java: add the same `if (event.getType() != ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE) { return; }` filter at the top of onChatMessage, before the text match (same import).

Step 8 - concerns.json: mark WRN-006 resolved - both listeners now filter by ChatMessageType.GAMEMESSAGE, closing the chat-spoofing exploit vector confirmed via a real Discord incident. Note in the resolution that OneTimeRewardListener's exact wording is still best-effort/unconfirmed against a live client, but the spoofing risk itself is closed.

verification.notes: Definition of done confirmed (all 8 plan steps complete, conventions followed, no unit tests since no test framework exists in this repo - TD-001, no staging branch in use here). Concerns check: WRN-006 marked resolved (spoofing half), WRN-007 and WRN-008 newly logged during execution, both transparently. Dev UAT: compile + two live client boots confirmed; the actual game-content triggers (Mokhaiotl chest reward, real pet drop, real cape completion) cannot be reproduced in a dev environment - developer accepted shipping on code-review-level confidence plus compile/boot verification, consistent with how every other game-event-driven task in this repo has shipped.

ship.notes: No PR - direct merge per developer instruction, matching established repo pattern (no gh CLI available). Commit 080612d on bugfix/consolidate-loot-listeners, merged to main via --no-ff at 3034518, pushed to origin/main.
